messages.content: I’m ready to finish Boston. Before you charge anything, recheck the three names, both flight dates, seats, the suite occupancy, taxes, and the cancellation terms. If the numbers still match, book both.

The itinerary still prices at $2,767.32 total: $1,170 for the three round-trip tickets and $1,597.32 for the Cambridge suite. Travel is Thursday, October 9 through Monday, October 13. I need the exact ticket names as shown on each traveler’s ID before purchase.
Marcus Jian Lee, Daniel Robert Lee, and Owen Samuel Lee. Owen is 12.

Confirmed. The nonstop outbound is Thursday, October 9, ORD 5:10 p.m. to BOS 8:35 p.m. The nonstop return is Monday, October 13, BOS 6:15 p.m. to ORD 8:02 p.m. The fare is $325 plus $65 in taxes and fees per person, or $390 each and $1,170 total. Standard seats remain available for all three, but the outbound map only has scattered seats: 18A, 24C, and 27D are the best current set. The return has 21D, 21E, and 21F together. Seat selection is included at no added charge.
That’s fine. Put Owen in 18A, Daniel in 24C, and me in 27D outbound. Keep us together on the return, with Owen in the middle.

Seat allocation is set for checkout: outbound Owen 18A, Daniel 24C, Marcus 27D; return Daniel 21D, Owen 21E, Marcus 21F. The Cambridge booking is one one-bedroom suite for three occupants, with one king bed and one full-size sofa bed. The property reconfirmed that the sofa bed will be opened and dressed before arrival and that Owen is included in the quoted occupancy.
Break down the hotel total once more. Also verify breakfast and the balcony note.

The suite is $339 per night for four nights, totaling $1,356 before tax. Lodging taxes are $241.32, producing the complete $1,597.32 hotel charge. There is no destination fee and no extra-person charge. Breakfast is included for Marcus, Daniel, and Owen each morning. The request reads: balcony suite preferred; if none is available, a first-floor suite is acceptable. The prepared sofa bed request is also attached. Room placement is a request, not guaranteed.
And the refund deadline is still October 8, correct? What happens after that?

Yes. The hotel can be canceled without penalty through 11:59 p.m. Eastern on Wednesday, October 8. After that deadline, the full $1,597.32 stay becomes nonrefundable. The airfare is the standard nonrefundable fare: cancellation would produce airline credit for each named traveler, subject to the fare rules, rather than a cash refund.
Good. For the airport, plan on a rideshare directly to the hotel Thursday night. No transit after landing.

Added. With the 8:35 p.m. arrival, allow time for deplaning and pickup, then approximately 20 to 35 minutes by rideshare from BOS to the Cambridge hotel, depending on tunnel and city traffic. The ride itself is not prepaid or included in the $2,767.32 booking total.
Everything matches. Book the flights and the Cambridge suite now.

Both bookings are confirmed. Flights for Marcus Jian Lee, Daniel Robert Lee, and Owen Samuel Lee are booked for Thursday, October 9 and Monday, October 13 under confirmation B7Q2LN, totaling $1,170. Seats are Owen 18A, Daniel 24C, and Marcus 27D outbound; Daniel 21D, Owen 21E, and Marcus 21F return. The Cambridge one-bedroom suite is booked October 9-13 under confirmation CAM-804731 for $1,597.32 including all taxes and all three guests. Breakfast for three is included, the sofa bed preparation is confirmed, and the balcony-first-floor room request is noted. Free hotel cancellation ends at 11:59 p.m. Eastern October 8; afterward the full stay is charged. Combined airfare and lodging are $2,767.32. On arrival Thursday, take a rideshare from BOS directly to the hotel; expected driving time is 20 to 35 minutes.
